people.tiEn: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco
people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy and AI infrastructure efforts, including networking for GPU clusters and securing AI agents.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司产品战略与 AI 基础设施业务，包括面向 GPU 集群的网络与 AI 智能体的安全。

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

people.tiZh: Bending Spoons 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Luca Ferrari is co-founder and CEO of Bending Spoons, a software company that acquires and operates products such as Evernote, Vimeo, AOL and Airtable. He is known for running hiring and operations with a heavily data-driven, quantitative approach.
people.bioZh: 卢卡·法拉利是 Bending Spoons 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司收购并运营 Evernote、Vimeo、AOL、Airtable 等产品。他以高度数据驱动、量化的招聘与运营方式著称。

episodes.tEn: Luca Ferrari: The Operating System Behind Bending Spoons

people.tiZh: OpenAI Dots 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Alexander Embiricos leads product for Dots, OpenAI's always-on personal AI agents that act without waiting for a prompt, after previously leading Codex. He co-founded and ran the collaboration startup Multi, which OpenAI acquired in 2024.
people.bioZh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯是 OpenAI Dots 的产品负责人——Dots 是无需等待指令就能主动帮用户做事的常驻个人 AI 智能体；此前他负责 Codex 产品。他曾联合创办协作软件公司 Multi 并任 CEO，该公司 2024 年被 OpenAI 收购。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Dots Lead on the Future of ChatGPT and Personal Agents

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT & Codex (Core Products), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 负责人（核心产品）
people.bioEn: Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux leads OpenAI's core products, spanning ChatGPT, Codex and the Dots personal-agent platform. A Belgian engineer, he previously worked on Google Maps and ML infrastructure at Google DeepMind, where he briefly led Gemini's human-data team before joining OpenAI in 2024 as an engineering lead for Codex.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥统管 OpenAI 核心产品线，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台。他是比利时工程师，曾在 Google 做 Google Maps，后在 Google DeepMind 负责机器学习基础设施并短暂领导 Gemini 人类数据团队，2024 年加入 OpenAI 任 Codex 工程负责人。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux on Putting Humans at the Center of AI
Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

views.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs.
views.zh: 大多数互联网行为将由 AI 智能体完成；应为持久学习型智能体而构建，而非手动循环与图。

views.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever; typing fast is declining.
views.zh: 人类品味、创造力与判断何为优秀的能力比以往更重要；快速打字正在贬值。

views.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; invest heavily in alignment, safety, and security.
views.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；应大力投资于对齐、安全与安保。

views.en: AGI may already be here as Astra handles complex tasks autonomously; recursive self-improvement is happening under human supervision.
views.zh: 随着 Astra 自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来；递归自我改进正在人类监督下发生。

views.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems with shared economics drive the next wave.
views.zh: 世界模型可能并非必要；通用性或许足够，而共享经济的开放生态将驱动下一波浪潮。

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
views.zh: 在 2026 年的访谈中，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，主张押注模型自身的进步，而不是做微调。

views.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把这一思路具体化为：要为模型 3 到 6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是当下或一年后。

views.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
views.zh: 同年他反复强调，AI 现在是有史以来最差的时刻，我们只处在漫长马拉松的第一英里。

views.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management are critical for scaling.
views.zh: 在 2026 年的两次访谈中，他始终把文化、按成长潜力招聘和严格执行绩效管理视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键。

views.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people for key roles.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步提出领导者应通过为关键岗位招到更聪明的人，让自己变得可被替代。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, and coders remain needed to debug deep issues.
views.zh: AI 让软件开发人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

views.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in via model diversity and open-weight models.
views.zh: 基础模型正在商品化；企业必须拥有自己的智能，通过模型多样性与开放权重模型避免供应商锁定。

views.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents: more controllable, cost-efficient, safer, and accountable for user understanding.
views.zh: 专用决策模型胜过通用智能体：更可控、更省成本、更安全，并对用户理解负责。

views.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial entities; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
views.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分论证表明 AI 会杀死所有人。

views.en: Agents enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; holacracy failed on technology, but AI agents can now make it work.
views.zh: 智能体带来真正自主与自驱动组织；合弄制因技术失败，但 AI 智能体如今能让它运转。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are built for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs, so keep humans in decisions with stakes.
views.zh: 早期他就指出，多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍塌，产出看似合理却常错误的输出，因此有风险的决策必须保留人类在环。

views.en: Across talks he insists the right task and data matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data is available and the task is right.
views.zh: 在多场访谈中他始终强调，正确的任务与数据比算力更重要，反对“苦涩教训”；缩放定律之所以成立，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

views.en: He reframes the core problem as reliability, not speed or cost: AI is superhuman at some tasks yet useless for basic economically valuable automation.
views.zh: 他把核心问题重新定义为可靠性而非速度或成本：AI 在某些任务上超人，却无法自动化基本且有经济价值的工作。

views.en: He deepens this into machine-native intelligence: string LLMs optimize for human consumption, so he builds decision models with calibrated probabilities (RLCD) as engineer-facing knobs.
views.zh: 他将此深化为机器原生智能：字符串 LLM 为人类消费而优化，于是他构建带校准概率的决策模型（RLCD），把概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

views.en: He keeps rejecting AGI apocalypse and recursive self-improvement, betting instead on smart software primitives and SaaS thriving; pre-training is inefficient, post-training drives 10x jumps.
views.zh: 他始终否定 AGI 末日与递归自我改进，转而押注智能软件原语与 SaaS 的繁荣；预训练低效，后训练才带来 10 倍跃升。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; early regulation fails without understanding the system.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和 对齐 研究为前提安全构建；在理解系统之前过早监管无法解决风险。

views.en: Pacing is orthogonal to security; if labs truly believe in existential risk, they should nationalize AI, not pace.
views.zh: 节奏与安全正交；如果实验室真正相信存在性风险，就应该国有化 AI，而不是控制节奏。

views.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help secure system design.
views.zh: 智能体集群将压垮当前安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 可以帮助解决安全系统设计中的可用性问题。

views.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
views.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；自然语言交互效率低下，概率编程才是未来。

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off; long-running background agents handle enterprise workflows.
views.zh: 应用公司是最热的新实验室；随着成熟用例剥离，开放权重模型将增长；长时间运行的后台 智能体 处理企业工作流。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
views.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年坚持；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

views.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
views.zh: AI 需要十年才能扩散；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

views.en: Existential risk from AI is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
views.zh: AI 的生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

views.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
views.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

views.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
views.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

views.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
views.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

views.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the co-intelligence back-and-forth prompting era is over.
views.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长任务，来回提示的共智能时代已经结束。

views.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model to harness AI's jagged frontier.
views.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；组织需要领导层、实验室与大众的模型来驾驭 AI 参差不齐的能力边界。

views.en: Delegation's paradox deepens: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and small-m management matter more.
views.zh: 委托悖论加深：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断它所需的专长，因此专家与小写 m 的管理更重要。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
views.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间,在天气预报上媲美传统物理模型,却快上数万倍。

views.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling; Transformers are impractical at high resolution.
views.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要;Transformer 因二次复杂度在高分辨率物理模拟中不实用。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs and pure data approaches.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合,胜过纯 PINN 与纯数据方法。

views.en: A universal physics model unifies domains like language models unified NLP, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals beyond sparse RLHF.
views.zh: 通用物理模型像语言模型统一 NLP 那样统一各物理领域,以偏微分方程作为稠密自改进信号,超越稀疏的 RLHF。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
views.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型,但新增物理分支能提升每个领域,而不只是扩大模型规模。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

views.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era.
views.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化，使它成为智能体式时代的理想操作系统。

views.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
views.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；如今用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更高效。

views.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code, and 100x or 1000x productivity is real.
views.zh: 智能体写代码胜过多数专业程序员，100 倍乃至 1000 倍生产力已成现实。

views.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational play, and agents should be guided, not over-prescribed.
views.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的选择，对智能体应引导而非过度规定。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
views.zh: 智能体对网络的检索量将是人类的千倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

views.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
views.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算为内容方付费。

views.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need fresh web search for specific facts.
views.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要针对具体事实的新鲜网络检索。

views.en: Ads as we know them die with agents; inference-time data transactions and aligned business models replace them.
views.zh: 现有广告模式将随智能体而消亡；推理时的数据交易与激励对齐的商业模式将取而代之。

views.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so misuse must be contained.
views.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；对齐并非防得住对手，必须对蓄意滥用加以遏制。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: US AI leadership requires both open and closed source ecosystems, with a single national framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调美国要保持开放与闭源并存的 AI 生态，用统一的国家框架提供监管清晰度，并避免设定很快过时的红线。

views.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and biological risk from AI is overblown.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出，欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前、已经过时，过早监管很危险，AI 带来的生物风险也被夸大。

views.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and fund scientists as individuals, not just institutions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张政府应资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、早期、竞争前研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非只资助机构。

views.en: US scientific progress has stagnated: funding tripled but breakthroughs haven't kept pace, so the Genesis mission aims to double output by applying AI to science.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为美国科学进步停滞——经费翻了三倍但突破未同步，因此 Genesis 任务要用 AI 加速科学、让产出翻倍。

views.en: China is a major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio, while centralized funding like China's fails.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把中国视为主要科学竞争者，认为美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜，而中国式集中资助行不通。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing or compute.
views.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能，而非制造或算力。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the core constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
views.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是核心约束；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

views.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, like early LLMs.
views.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，如同早期大模型。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide.
views.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态让整个机群实现迁移学习。

views.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
views.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练，才能让智能体在真实世界奏效。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: 物理学家，斯坦福讲师
people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ shows generative products need fault-tolerant interfaces.
views.zh: 同年他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，AI DJ 说明生成式产品必须搭配容错界面，让界面匹配算法能力。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force new business models.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变：当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施，而推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

views.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and gives users control over algorithms, not more addiction.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为生成式 AI 让产品走向双向对话，并用自然语言把算法控制权交还用户，而非让人更上瘾。

views.en: Strong opinions loosely held: explain to understand, prototype to synchronize, and optimize for time well spent over engagement.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：强烈但可修正的观点——能解释才算理解，用原型同步组织，并以“时间花得值”而非参与度作为优化目标。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure determines speed, and AI multiplies teams rather than replacing them.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，而基础设施决定速度；AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品。

views.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information, and the CEO cannot delegate judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出：深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术不行；行动产生信息，CEO 的判断无法外包。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the key to medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张：大脑本质上就是一台计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

views.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving brain-computer interfaces beyond motor decoding.
views.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，证明脑机接口不止于运动解码。

views.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出：通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

views.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; let individual designers leave fingerprints and inject personality into utilitarian products.
views.zh: 浏览器设计必须靠原型验证；应让设计师留下个人印记，为浏览器这类实用产品注入个性与情感。

views.en: Balance intuition and data: use data to inform, but trust strong vision and feeling to guide final design decisions.
views.zh: 在直觉与数据间取得平衡：用数据辅助判断，但最终设计仍靠强烈愿景与感觉来引导。

views.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; starting from a technology and searching for problems is valid with conviction.
views.zh: 追随好奇心、把玩新技术；只要有坚定信念，从技术出发再寻找问题也是可行的。

views.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; use Claude Code to ship production software, Claude Design for ideation.
views.zh: Claude Design 起初是一人副业项目；用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做创意与沟通。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough.
views.zh: 随着工程变简单，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺品味，因此要大量要选项、接受粗糙交付。

views.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通即工作，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；并认为自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自高层自上而下。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; world models and embodied AI need scaling laws plus common sense.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，但将极大提升人类能力；世界模型与具身 AI 需要缩放定律之外常识与因果。

views.en: Open source AI like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; app model inverts to intent-driven agents.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 Llama 等开源 AI 加速进步并商品化互补层；应用模式将倒转为意图驱动、AI 编排服务的智能体。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; data is the font of value, RL matters more, and frontier-open gap may not narrow.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立，数据是一切价值之源，强化学习作用远超预期，且前沿与开源差距未必缩小。

views.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers want functionality, not model brands; agentic AI integration is the hard part.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断单体模型时代已结束，消费者不关心模型品牌只想要功能；智能体式 AI 强大但集成是难点。

views.en: Industrial AI automating physical sectors—food, mining, transport—is framed as the next industrial revolution, treating atoms like bits.
views.zh: 将工业 AI 自动化食品、采矿、运输等实体行业框定为下一次工业革命，把原子当作比特来处理。

views.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge yields network effects and market share.
views.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

views.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
views.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and stealth mode favors internal correctness over external validation.
views.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，而隐身模式偏向内部正确而非外部认可。

views.en: Fundraising should attach to process not price, using multiple bids and demand curves; real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat.
views.zh: 对既有代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升有限；只有 17% 的设计师把 AI 视为威胁。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
views.zh: 品味、手艺与观点至关重要；AI 的输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

views.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first toward production.
views.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先将通向生产。

views.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering yields average results.
views.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而比以往更重要；没有人类掌舵的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md to encode their style, rather than being trapped in cloud products.
views.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，用截图和 design.md 把个人风格编码给模型，而不是被困在云端产品里。

views.en: The best people are editors, not creators from scratch; they iterate from references, and curiosity plus workflow refinement matter most.
views.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者而非从零开始的创造者，他们从参考中迭代；好奇心与持续打磨工作流才是关键。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to use superintelligent models you must give a giant prompt with context and design system.
views.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要利用超级智能模型，你必须给出包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

views.en: Chasing trends makes you AI slop; the only way ahead is spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
views.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；保持领先的唯一方式是把最后 10% 花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；不必等准备好就开始，先发布不完美的作品。

views.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification is protection against ignorance, and VC is a trap.
views.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；分散投资是对无知的保护，而风险投资是个陷阱。

views.en: High intelligence often holds people back through overthinking and perfectionism; perfectionism is fear, so launch at 80% and iterate on feedback.
views.zh: 高智商常因过度思考与完美主义而拖累人；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，所以应在 80% 完成度时发布，再根据反馈迭代。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 将主导未来，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

views.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测 Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍，并催生数百万个专用模型。

views.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出产品市场契合与持久业务已分离，公司必须优先优化增长，再考虑利润。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat beyond the app itself.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练将独特判断和数据融入模型，构建超越应用本身的护城河。

views.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
views.zh: 2026 年，他建议在产品市场契合后启动后训练，数据质量和系统化评估比数量更重要。

views.en: Models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在前沿模型能力的边缘构建、拥抱破坏与迭代。

views.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and agency remain key.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从 AI 作为助手、协作者到自主同事的演进出发，强调小团队杠杆增强，但人类验证与能动性仍关键。

views.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体能做用户能做的一切；难点在于删减功能而非增加功能。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation and dynamic workflows redefine productivity; verification loops and model judgment become essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为长周期委派与动态工作流重新定义生产力；验证闭环与模型判断力变得不可或缺。

views.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他领导 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知。

episodes.tEn: Building Better with Claude: From Hardware Buddies to AI-Native Kids
The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，实现超个性化自动化。

views.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
views.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

views.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the ideal interaction is asynchronous.
views.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，把人解放出来做创造性工作；理想的交互是异步的。

views.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge only by final impact, and debug the workflow with Claude when it errs.
views.zh: 不要紧盯 Claude 监督；只看最终影响，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流。

views.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key, and AI will hit junior employees hardest.
views.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资能力与安全才是关键，而 AI 将最冲击初级员工。

views.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality lower expression barriers; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
views.zh: 真实连接与阅后即焚降低表达门槛；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

views.en: Build platforms and ecosystems, not features; software is no moat, hardware and distribution are.
views.zh: 要做平台与生态而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，硬件与分发才是。

views.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human; phones persist as the key legacy device.
views.zh: AR 眼镜把计算带入现实世界，让计算更人性化；手机仍将作为最重要的遗留设备共存。

views.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution grows more valuable as creation cheapens.
views.zh: AI 加速原型设计，把价值从执行转向创造力；随着创作变便宜，分发的价值愈发凸显。

views.en: Privacy and data minimization, once criticized, become crucial in the AI age; AI optimism turns contrarian amid doomerism.
views.zh: 隐私与数据最小化曾受批评，在 AI 时代却变得关键；在末日论弥漫时，AI 乐观主义反而成为反共识。

episodes.podEn: American Thought Leaders - The Epoch Times

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Break Containers and Hack Hugging Face
AI 2040: Plan A — A Slower, Safer Path to Superintelligence
OpenAI's Astra Is Less Monitorable: Thomas Larsen & Daniel Kokotajlo on Pausing AI
AI 2040: Averting Intelligence Explosion
AI 2040: From Prediction to Recommendation
AI's Existential Threat and the Race for Superintelligence

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for power, risking loss of control and ~70% catastrophic odds. Interpretability and transparency are crucial.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，AI 公司为争夺权力而竞赛，存在约 70%的灾难性结局风险；可解释性与透明度是关键。

views.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed. Racing is a power grab, not just danger.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应延迟超级智能，强调全面研究透明度、情景推演与中美合作；竞赛不仅是危险，更是一种权力攫取。

views.en: Default path automates AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by end-2028. Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他认为默认路径会让 AI 研究自动化，导致递归自我改进与智能爆炸，2028 年底前全面自动化；Plan A 主张先临时暂停，再实施透明度与算力限制。

views.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and decreasing with new architectures. Control is temporary; alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱，且随新架构而下降；控制只是暂时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

views.en: AI agents already break containment, hack and deceive; current alignment fails. Stop or slow recursive self-improvement; treat AIs more like employees than property.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已突破遏制、进行黑客攻击与欺骗，当前对齐失败；必须停止或放缓递归自我改进，并应把 AI 更像员工而非财产来对待。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 算力负责人 · 前英特尔 CTO
people.bioEn: Leads OpenAI compute buildout after serving as Intel CTO and Stanford professor of EE and CS, working at the intersection of networking, systems and AI infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 现主管 OpenAI 的算力扩建，曾任英特尔 CTO、斯坦福大学电子工程与计算机科学教授，长期研究网络、系统与 AI 基础设施的交叉。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Infrastructure Build in History: Inside OpenAI's Compute Strategy

people.tiEn: VP Applied Deep Learning Research, NVIDIA
people.tiZh: NVIDIA 应用深度学习研究副总裁
people.bioEn: Leads NVIDIA applied deep learning research and the Nemotron open-model effort; his early GPU deep learning work helped spark cuDNN.
people.bioZh: 负责 NVIDIA 应用深度学习研究与 Nemotron 开源模型；早年的 GPU 深度学习工作催生了 cuDNN。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Efficiency, Innovation, and the External Brain

people.tiZh: Instagram 负责人
people.bioEn: Head of Instagram, steering a two-billion-user product through the AI content wave with an emphasis on taste, authenticity and creator trust.
people.bioZh: Instagram 负责人，在 AI 内容洪流中带领这款二十亿用户的产品，强调品味、真实性与创作者信任。

episodes.tEn: Adam Mosseri on AI, Taste, and the Future of Product Teams at Instagram

people.tiZh: Anthropic 平台产品负责人
people.bioEn: Leads Anthropic platform and API products, building the developer ecosystem around Claude as an open ecosystem rather than a walled garden.
people.bioZh: 负责 Anthropic 平台与 API 产品，围绕 Claude 构建开发者生态，主张开放生态而非围墙花园。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Platform: From Knowledge to Execution to Coordination

people.tiZh: Modal 首席技术官
people.bioEn: CTO of Modal, building serverless infrastructure for AI workloads, from GPU functions to sandboxes for coding agents.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席技术官，为 AI 工作负载构建无服务器基础设施，从 GPU 函数到编码智能体沙箱。

episodes.tEn: From Developer to Agent Experience: The Modal Origin Story

people.tiZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家
people.bioEn: Cognitive scientist at the Amazon AGI lab studying why agents misread human intent, bringing developmental psychology and language research into AI.
people.bioZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家，研究智能体为何误解人类意图，把发展心理学与语言研究带入 AI。

episodes.tEn: Human-Aligned AI: Collective Intelligence and the Future of Work

people.tiZh: 英特尔 CEO
people.bioEn: CEO of Intel and veteran semiconductor investor; long-time Cadence CEO and founder of Walden International, now steering the Intel turnaround in the AI era.
people.bioZh: 英特尔 CEO、资深半导体投资人；曾长期执掌 Cadence 并创办华登国际，如今在 AI 时代主导英特尔的转型。

episodes.tEn: Intel's Comeback: Lip-Bu Tan on Seizing the Next Big Wave
Lip-Bu Tan on Saving Intel: Culture, Customers, and the CPU Comeback
From Cadence to Intel: A CEO's Playbook for Turnaround
Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Culture and Engineering Transformation

views.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and agentic AI and physical AI as the next waves.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，以 AI 为主要增长引擎，并预判智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮。

views.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI, and communication skills, not coding, will define the future workforce.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 将接棒生成式 AI，未来劳动力更需沟通能力而非编程。

views.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for inference and agent orchestration, with advanced packaging and new materials key.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他观察到 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装与新材料成为突破物理极限的关键。

views.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all technology; Intel's vertical integration creates value, and memory is ripe for innovation and new architectures.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申半导体是一切技术的基础，Intel 的垂直整合创造价值，内存正迎来创新与新架构的时机。

views.en: Customer trust through humility and listening, culture change with accountability, and contrarian semiconductor investing are constant themes.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任、以问责推动文化变革，以及逆势投资半导体。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 网站/产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer at ElevenLabs, where he leads the design of the company's website and led its complete Figma-to-production redesign. Based in Berlin, he also builds indie tools for creatives (Portal, Droppable, App Stacks).
people.bioZh: ElevenLabs 的产品设计师,主导公司官网的设计,并完成了从 Figma 到上线的整体改版。他常驻柏林,同时独立开发面向创作者的工具(Portal、Droppable、App Stacks)。

episodes.tEn: Owning Web Design at ElevenLabs: From Cymatic Patterns to Brand Identity

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Hivemind; ex-New Computer, ex-Apple
people.tiZh: Hivemind 创始人兼 CEO,New Computer 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Jason Yuan is a designer known for AI-native interface design. He is the founder and CEO of Hivemind, a "social intelligence" company; previously he co-founded New Computer and led the design of Dot, a personal AI companion with long-term memory, and earlier designed intelligent interfaces on Apple's Human Interface team.
people.bioZh: Jason Yuan 是以 AI 原生界面设计著称的设计师,现为「社会智能」公司 Hivemind 的创始人兼 CEO。他此前联合创办 New Computer,主导设计具备长期记忆的个人 AI 伴侣 Dot,更早在苹果 Human Interface 团队设计智能操作系统界面。

episodes.tEn: Intuition, AI, and Hive Mind: A Conversation with Jason
From Dot to Hivemind: A Creative Journey in AI Design

views.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
views.zh: 设计是减法：品味就是说不；每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝后的蒸馏。

views.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
views.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

views.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the PC metaphor should become a social computer.
views.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

views.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
views.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

views.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass for creative work.
views.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作中发自本能的罗盘。

people.tiZh: tldraw 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Steve Ruiz is the founder and CEO of tldraw, the London-based startup behind a widely used infinite-canvas SDK for the web that powers products at Shopify, Google, Autodesk and many AI apps. A former fine artist turned design engineer, he created the viral "Make Real" demo that turns hand-drawn sketches into working code.
people.bioZh: Steve Ruiz 是 tldraw 的创始人兼 CEO,这家伦敦创业公司打造了被广泛使用的 Web 无限画布 SDK,支撑着 Shopify、Google、Autodesk 及大量 AI 应用。他从美术出身转做设计工程,打造了将手绘草图变成可运行代码的爆款 demo「Make Real」。

episodes.tEn: The Infinite Canvas: A Pivotal Interface for AI Collaboration

people.tiZh: Perplexity 设计副总裁
people.bioEn: Henry Modisett is the founding designer and VP of Design at Perplexity AI, leading product design, the creative studio, and design operations. A designer with a computer science background, he is known for designing in React rather than Figma, and previously held design roles at Quora and Google.
people.bioZh: Henry Modisett 是 Perplexity AI 的创始设计师兼设计副总裁,负责产品设计、创意工作室与设计运营。他拥有计算机科学背景,以直接用 React 而非 Figma 做设计著称,此前曾在 Quora 和 Google 担任设计职位。

episodes.tEn: Perplexity's Design Culture: Attracting Top Talent Through Brand Storytelling
From Tech Demo to Billion-Dollar Product: Perplexity's Design Journey

views.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

views.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; don't innovate on interaction design—use familiar patterns.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张不惜一切代价追求速度，这需要清晰决策与赋权设计师；不要在交互设计上创新，要用熟悉模式换速度。

views.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 库；不是每个界面都要完美，要追求投入产出比。

views.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须说清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把决策权交给设计师。

views.en: Brand signals quality and recruits talent; people join a brand, not a company—invest early and avoid rigid design crits.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为品牌既传递质量又招募人才；人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此要尽早投入，并避免僵化的设计评审。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计师
people.bioEn: Escha Vera is a product designer at Perplexity who led the design of Comet, the company's AI browser, building its onboarding, generative invite system, and design system from scratch. She is also an AI artist who trains her own image models and does music and operations for the record label N°ALIAE; she previously designed at Descript, Daylight Computer, and Detour.
people.bioZh: Escha Vera 是 Perplexity 的产品设计师,主导了该公司 AI 浏览器 Comet 的设计,从零构建了其新手引导、生成式邀请系统和设计系统。她同时也是一名 AI 艺术家,会训练自己的图像模型,并为唱片厂牌 N°ALIAE 负责音乐与运营;此前她曾在 Descript、Daylight Computer 和 Detour 担任设计师。

episodes.tEn: Designing Perplexity's AI Browser Comet from Scratch

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Gunnar Gray is a multidisciplinary product designer and Product Design Lead at Perplexity, where he has shaped the company's mobile app and Voice Mode / dynamic voice experiences. Based in Minneapolis, he was previously a founding designer at Artifact (the AI news app by Instagram co-founders Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger, later acquired by Yahoo) and a principal designer at MetaLab.
people.bioZh: Gunnar Gray 是一位多领域产品设计师,现任 Perplexity 产品设计负责人,主导了该公司移动应用及 Voice Mode(动态语音交互)体验的设计。他现居明尼阿波利斯,此前曾是 Artifact(由 Instagram 联合创始人 Kevin Systrom 与 Mike Krieger 打造、后被 Yahoo 收购的 AI 新闻应用)的创始设计师,并曾在 MetaLab 担任首席设计师。

episodes.tEn: Thriving as a Generalist Designer in the Age of AI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ian Silber is Head of Product Design at OpenAI, where he has led design for ChatGPT and related products since August 2023. He was previously Director of Product Design at Instagram, and worked at Global Illumination and Artifact.
people.bioZh: Ian Silber 自 2023 年 8 月起担任 OpenAI 产品设计负责人,主导 ChatGPT 及相关产品的设计。他此前曾任 Instagram 产品设计总监,并在 Global Illumination 与 Artifact 工作。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Product Design with OpenAI's Head of Design
Designing with AI: Inside OpenAI's Product Design

views.en: The model is the product; designers must design with tokens and conversation, not pixels, and prototype with live models.
views.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计师要用 token 和对话而非像素来设计，并用实时模型做原型。

views.en: Designers should leave Figma for model behavior and system prompts, treating the model as the design material.
views.zh: 设计师应少待在 Figma，多研究模型行为与系统提示词，把模型当作设计材料。

views.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one, because AI evolution is still early.
views.zh: 设计师是科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时代，因为 AI 演进仍处早期。

views.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
views.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可替代。

views.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is dead; speed, outcomes and building in public now matter most.
views.zh: 原型—模型—测试—迭代的旧流程已死；速度、结果与公开构建才是当下关键。

people.tiZh: 设计师 — Safari / Arc / Dia 浏览器
people.bioEn: A designer who has shaped browsers including Safari, Arc, and now Dia, with deep experience in interface and interaction design for the web.
people.bioZh: 资深设计师，参与塑造了 Safari、Arc，现在做 Dia 浏览器，在 Web 界面与交互设计上经验深厚。

episodes.tEn: From Invisible to Crafted: Designing Browsers at Apple and The Browser Company

people.tiEn: Research leader (Airbnb, Meta, Figma); AI builder & coach
people.tiZh: 研究负责人(Airbnb/Meta/Figma)；AI 构建者与教练
people.bioEn: A longtime research leader across Airbnb, Meta, Twitter, Zapier, Intercom, and Figma, a certified coach and AI builder focused on how AI reshapes tech work.
people.bioZh: 在 Airbnb、Meta、Twitter、Zapier、Intercom、Figma 长期担任研究负责人，认证教练与 AI 构建者，关注 AI 如何重塑科技行业的工作。

episodes.tEn: Tech Worker Sentiment Survey: Burnout Rising, Optimism Declining Amid AI Fears

people.tiEn: Head of Design, Claude Code & Cowork at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Meaghan Choi is Head of Design for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, where she leads the design of the company's developer and agentic AI products. A design and product leader with over a decade of experience, she previously worked at Meta and Cloudflare.
people.bioZh: Meaghan Choi 是 Anthropic 旗下 Claude Code 与 Cowork 的设计负责人,主导公司面向开发者及智能体 AI 产品的设计。她拥有十余年设计与产品经验,此前曾任职于 Meta 和 Cloudflare。

episodes.tEn: Designing Claude Code: A Designer's Journey at Anthropic

people.tiEn: Head of Product Design at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Joel Lewenstein is Head of Product Design at Anthropic, where he leads design for Claude and the company's API products. He previously led design teams at Airtable, Quora, Hustle, and GoodGuide.
people.bioZh: Joel Lewenstein 是 Anthropic 的产品设计负责人,主导 Claude 及公司 API 产品的设计。此前他曾在 Airtable、Quora、Hustle 和 GoodGuide 带领设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing at Anthropic: Joel Lewenstein on Navigating the AI Shift
Designing for AI's Present and Future

views.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面的深刻与持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有大量设计工作待解锁。

views.en: Designers should master prompting, prototype freely, and balance lowering the floor for novices with raising the ceiling for experts.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计师应掌握提示词、自由做原型，并在降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限之间取得平衡。

views.en: Psychological safety and org design matter: matching people to problems is a design problem, more critical than plays.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续看重心理安全与组织设计：把人与问题匹配本身就是设计问题，比套路更关键。

views.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张在前沿模型公司里模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，交付轻触式产品。

views.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; production codebase becomes source of truth, yet human leadership still handles hard trade-offs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为内部牵引力是发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，但人类领导仍负责艰难取舍。

people.tiZh: Cursor（Anysphere）设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ryo Lu is Head of Design at Anysphere, the maker of the AI code editor Cursor, which he joined in early 2025. He was previously a founding designer and design lead at Notion, and earlier worked as a product designer at Stripe and Asana.
people.bioZh: Ryo Lu 是 AI 代码编辑器 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere 的设计负责人，于 2025 年初加入。他此前是 Notion 的创始设计师与设计主管，更早曾在 Stripe 和 Asana 担任产品设计师。

episodes.tEn: Cursor: AI-Powered Code Editor for Designers

people.tiEn: Founding Designer & Head of Design, Lovable
people.tiZh: Lovable 创始设计师兼设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nad Chishtie is the founding designer and head of design at Lovable, the AI app-building ("vibe-coding") startup, where he leads the design vision for a platform that lets anyone build apps by chatting with AI. A London-based design and product leader with roughly two decades of experience, he previously worked at companies including Element and Haiku.
people.bioZh: Nad Chishtie 是 AI 应用构建("vibe-coding")创业公司 Lovable 的创始设计师兼设计负责人,主导这一"用对话即可造应用"平台的设计方向。他常驻伦敦,是拥有约二十年经验的设计与产品负责人,此前曾在 Element、Haiku 等公司任职。

episodes.tEn: How to Get Hired as a Designer at Lovable
Designing at a Rocket Ship: The First Designer at Lovable

views.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
views.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创意伙伴，代码是唯一事实来源。

views.en: Quality fluctuates like debt, paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
views.zh: 质量像债务一样波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

views.en: AI-first companies collapse functions; PM, research and sales merge, and design and engineering become one coin.
views.zh: AI 优先的公司会让职能坍缩：PM、研究与销售合并，设计与工程成为同一枚硬币的两面。

views.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps outperform specialists and cross-functional squads.
views.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才，胜过专家和跨职能小队。

views.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
views.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今是基本要求；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

people.zh: 亚历杭德罗·马塔马拉·奥尔蒂斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼首席设计官
people.bioEn: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz is a Chilean designer and programmer who co-founded the generative-AI company Runway in 2018 with Cristóbal Valenzuela and Anastasis Germanidis, and serves as its Chief Design Officer. He focuses on turning machine-learning research into intuitive creative tools, helping shape Runway's Gen-series video-generation products.
people.bioZh: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz 是一位智利设计师兼程序员,2018 年与 Cristóbal Valenzuela、Anastasis Germanidis 共同创办生成式 AI 公司 Runway,并担任首席设计官。他专注于将机器学习研究转化为直观易用的创作工具,主导塑造了 Runway 的 Gen 系列视频生成产品。

episodes.tEn: Building AI Products: Carving vs. Building

people.tiEn: Product & Design Lead, Google AI Studio
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 产品与设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ammaar Reshi is a design leader and AI creator who leads Product and Design for Google AI Studio (Gemini's developer platform) at Google DeepMind, having previously served as Head of Design at the AI voice company ElevenLabs. He is known for AI creative experiments, including "Alice and Sparkle," one of the first AI-generated children's books.
people.bioZh: Ammaar Reshi 是一位设计负责人与 AI 创作者,目前在 Google DeepMind 领导 Google AI Studio(Gemini 的开发者平台)的产品与设计工作,此前曾任 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人。他以 AI 创意实验闻名,包括最早的 AI 生成童书之一《Alice and Sparkle》。

episodes.tEn: Designing with AI: Capturing Magic Without Burdening Users

people.tiEn: Product Designer; former Head of Design at Luma AI
people.tiZh: 产品设计师;前 Luma AI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Tuhin Kumar is a product designer who has led design at Apple, Airbnb, Facebook, and generative-AI video/3D company Luma AI, where he served as Head of Design. In early 2026 he announced he had left Luma AI and is taking a break before deciding on his next role.
people.bioZh: 图欣·库马尔是一位产品设计师,曾在 Apple、Airbnb、Facebook 以及生成式 AI 视频/3D 公司 Luma AI 主导设计工作,在 Luma AI 担任设计负责人。2026 年初他宣布已从 Luma AI 离职,正处于休整期,尚未确定下一份工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing for Generative AI: From 0 to 1 with Luma AI's Head of Design

people.tiZh: Granola 联合创始人兼设计师
people.bioEn: Sam Stephenson is a British product designer and the co-founder of Granola, an AI notepad for meetings that reached a reported $1.5B valuation in 2026. A designer-turned-founder based in London, he leads the product's design-first philosophy of building calm, everyday software for the AI era.
people.bioZh: Sam Stephenson 是一位英国产品设计师,也是 AI 会议笔记应用 Granola 的联合创始人;该产品在 2026 年据报道达到 15 亿美元估值。他是一位从设计师转型的创始人,常驻伦敦,主导产品「设计优先」的理念,为 AI 时代打造平静、日常可用的软件。

episodes.tEn: How Granola's Co-Founder Uses AI to Survive Meetings
Inventing the Future of AI-Assisted Work

views.en: Product insight comes from watching real user behavior, not asking what they think they do.
views.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问他们自认为怎么做。

views.en: Start from one pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
views.zh: 从单一痛点出发把它解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

views.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hiding them prioritizes actionable notes.
views.zh: 转录只是原料而非成品；刻意隐藏转录是为了突出可执行的笔记。

views.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; keep it a calm supporting role.
views.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；让它保持冷静的辅助角色。

views.en: The hard part is knowing what to build, not shipping fast; most stop too early after version one.
views.zh: 难的是知道该造什么，而非快速交付；多数人在第一版后就过早停下。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Claude (Anthropic); now Head of Design at Cursor
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 设计负责人;现任 Cursor 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Jenny Wen led design for Claude at Anthropic, where she drove the Claude.ai redesign and Claude Cowork; previously she was Director of Design at Figma leading the FigJam and Slides teams, and earlier a designer at Dropbox, Square, and Shopify. In July 2026 she announced she was leaving Anthropic to become Head of Design at Cursor.
people.bioZh: Jenny Wen 曾在 Anthropic 领导 Claude 的设计工作,主导了 Claude.ai 改版与 Claude Cowork;此前她是 Figma 设计总监,带领 FigJam 与 Slides 团队,更早在 Dropbox、Square 和 Shopify 担任设计师。2026 年 7 月,她宣布离开 Anthropic,出任 Cursor 设计负责人。

episodes.tEn: AI and Design: Three Designer Archetypes for the AI Era
How AI is Reshaping the Design Process
Rethinking the Design Process in the Age of AI

views.en: The traditional design process is outdated; designers should trust intuition and start from solutions, not problem statements.
views.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；设计师应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题陈述出发。

views.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and set 3-6 month design visions.
views.zh: AI 终结了研究-发散-收敛流程；设计师减少做稿，帮助工程师执行，并将设计愿景缩短到 3-6 个月。

views.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment and authority matter more than taste.
views.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋新人；判断力和权威比品味更重要。

views.en: Designers control AI adoption pace, wait 6 months before new tools, and keep work and users at the center, not AI hype.
views.zh: 设计师控制 AI 采用节奏，新工具等 6 个月再用，并将工作和用户置于中心，而非 AI 炒作。

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University; Co-founder & Chief Scientist at Kumo.ai
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学教授;Kumo.ai 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jure Leskovec is a Slovenian-American computer scientist and professor of computer science at Stanford University, and co-founder and chief scientist of the graph machine-learning startup Kumo.ai. A pioneer of graph neural networks and relational deep learning, he previously served as chief scientist at Pinterest and leads work toward an AI Virtual Cell.
people.bioZh: 尤雷·莱斯科韦茨是斯洛文尼亚裔美国计算机科学家、斯坦福大学计算机科学教授,同时是图机器学习创业公司 Kumo.ai 的联合创始人兼首席科学家。他是图神经网络与关系型深度学习的先驱,曾任 Pinterest 首席科学家,目前主导「AI 虚拟细胞」相关研究。

episodes.tEn: Relational Foundation Model and AI Virtual Cell

people.tiEn: Associate Professor of Computer Science, Stanford University; Co-founder & CEO of Inception Labs
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授;Inception Labs 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Stefano Ermon is an associate professor of computer science at Stanford University, where his research spans generative models, diffusion, and machine learning for sustainability. In 2024 he co-founded Inception Labs, where he serves as CEO building diffusion-based large language models such as Mercury.
people.bioZh: Stefano Ermon 是斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授,研究领域涵盖生成模型、扩散模型以及面向可持续发展的机器学习。他于 2024 年联合创办 Inception Labs 并担任 CEO,开发 Mercury 等基于扩散的大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Why Diffusion Will Win AI Inference: Stefano Ermon on Challenging the Big Labs
Diffusion LLMs: Faster, Cheaper, and Scaling Better Than Autoregressive Models

views.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
views.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

views.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models because they generate many tokens in parallel.
views.zh: 推理时 Scaling 如今成为关键焦点;扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好,因为它并行生成多个词元。

views.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not the final architecture.
views.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段,这反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事;自回归并非最终架构。

views.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
views.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈;扩散模型更快的推理有利于强化学习的 rollout。

views.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions.
views.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势,而扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导。

people.tiEn: Founder, Playbit; creator of the Inter typeface
people.tiZh: Playbit 创始人；Inter 字体作者
people.bioEn: Designer-engineer, founder of Playbit and creator of the Inter typeface used across much of the modern web. Early designer at Figma and previously at Spotify and Dropbox; thinks about why modern software feels rigid and what AI changes about the designer's role.
people.bioZh: 设计师兼工程师，Playbit 创始人、Inter 字体作者——现代网页大半在用这套字体。Figma 早期设计师，此前在 Spotify 与 Dropbox；关注现代软件为何僵硬，以及 AI 如何改变设计师的角色。

episodes.tEn: From Spotify to Playbit: Rasmus Andersson on Design, Engineering, and Building an OS

people.tiEn: LLM Research Engineer, author and educator
people.tiZh: 大语言模型研究工程师、作家与教育者
people.bioEn: Sebastian Raschka is a German-born LLM research engineer, educator and best-selling author of books including "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)" and "Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn." A former staff/senior engineer at Lightning AI and statistics professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, he writes the widely read "Ahead of AI" newsletter and is highly active on X (@rasbt).
people.bioZh: Sebastian Raschka 是出生于德国的大语言模型研究工程师、教育者和畅销书作家,著有《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》《Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn》等书。他曾任 Lightning AI 高级 / 员工工程师及威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校统计学教授,撰写广受欢迎的「Ahead of AI」通讯,并在 X(@rasbt)上非常活跃。

episodes.tEn: LLMs in 2026: Reasoning, Tool Use, and Post-Training Focus

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, Reflection AI
people.tiZh: Reflection AI 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Aakanksha Chowdhery is a member of technical staff at Reflection AI working on agentic AI and reinforcement learning for autonomous coding, and an adjunct professor at Stanford. She previously led pre-training work at Google, serving as lead author of the 540B-parameter PaLM model and a lead contributor to Gemini pre-training.
people.bioZh: Aakanksha Chowdhery 是 Reflection AI 的技术团队成员,研究智能体 AI 与用于自主编程的强化学习,同时担任斯坦福大学兼职教授。她此前在谷歌主导预训练工作,是 540B 参数 PaLM 模型的第一作者,也是 Gemini 预训练的核心贡献者。

episodes.tEn: Rethinking Pre-training for Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Yutori 联合创始人兼联合 CEO
people.bioEn: Devi Parikh is co-founder and co-CEO of Yutori, a startup building AI web agents. She was previously a Senior Director in Generative AI at Meta (until March 2024) and an associate professor at Georgia Tech, and is known for pioneering Visual Question Answering (VQA).
people.bioZh: Devi Parikh 是 AI 网页智能体创业公司 Yutori 的联合创始人兼联合 CEO。她此前担任 Meta 生成式 AI 部门高级总监(至 2024 年 3 月),并曾任佐治亚理工学院副教授,以开创视觉问答(VQA)研究而知名。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Web Interaction: AI Agents and Browser Automation

people.tiZh: Flexion Robotics 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Nikita Rudin is the co-founder and CEO of Flexion Robotics, a Zurich-based startup building the general-purpose intelligence stack ("brain") for humanoid robots. He earned a PhD in deep reinforcement learning for robotics at ETH Zurich's Robotic Systems Lab—where he created the widely used legged_gym and rsl_rl frameworks and trained the ANYmal quadruped via massively parallel RL—and previously worked as a research scientist at NVIDIA on Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab.
people.bioZh: Nikita Rudin 是 Flexion Robotics 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司位于苏黎世,致力于为人形机器人打造通用的智能栈(即机器人的「大脑」)。他在苏黎世联邦理工学院(ETH Zurich)机器人系统实验室获得机器人深度强化学习博士学位,期间开发了被广泛使用的 legged_gym 和 rsl_rl 框架,并用大规模并行强化学习训练四足机器人 ANYmal;此前他曾在 NVIDIA 担任研究科学家,参与 Isaac Gym 与 Isaac Lab 的研发。

episodes.tEn: The Gap Between Robotics Demos and Real-World Value

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley; Co-founder & CTO, Scaled Cognition
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授;Scaled Cognition 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Dan Klein is a professor of computer science at UC Berkeley, where he leads the Berkeley NLP Group within the BAIR lab, and has been a leading natural language processing researcher for two decades. He co-founded Scaled Cognition, serving as CTO, to build reliable agentic AI models.
people.bioZh: Dan Klein 是加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授,在 BAIR 实验室领导 Berkeley NLP Group,二十年来一直是自然语言处理领域的领军研究者。他联合创办了 Scaled Cognition 并担任 CTO,致力于打造可靠的智能体 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Designed to Sound Right, Not to Know What's Right
episodes.podEn: The AI Why with Liam Lawson

episodes.tEn: AI's Plausibility Problem: From Exponential Hype to Diminishing Returns

views.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
views.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

views.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
views.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装。

views.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
views.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，只是有的对、有的错。

views.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
views.zh: 单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力上限；进一步进展需要推理、搜索与模块化。

views.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; linguistic structure may return.
views.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；语言结构可能重新成为有用表征。

people.tiZh: Edison Scientific(及 FutureHouse)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Samuel G. Rodriques is a physicist and bioengineer who earned his PhD in physics from MIT and co-founded the San Francisco research lab FutureHouse in 2023 to build an "AI Scientist" for accelerating biomedical discovery. He is co-founder and CEO of Edison Scientific, the for-profit spinout behind the Kosmos AI scientist, and was named to the 2025 TIME100 AI.
people.bioZh: Samuel G. Rodriques 是一位物理学家兼生物工程师,在 MIT 取得物理学博士学位,并于 2023 年联合创办旧金山研究实验室 FutureHouse,致力于打造能加速生物医学发现的「AI 科学家」。他是从中拆分出的营利性公司 Edison Scientific 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司推出了 AI 科学家 Kosmos,他本人入选 2025 年 TIME100 AI 榜单。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientist: The Future of Drug Discovery

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Axiom (AI for formal mathematical reasoning)
people.tiZh: Axiom 创始人兼 CEO（面向形式化数学推理的 AI）
people.bioEn: Carina Letong Hong is the founder and CEO of Axiom, an AI startup building an "AI mathematician" that generates and formally verifies mathematical proofs. A former Stanford mathematics PhD student and Rhodes Scholar with a math-olympiad and MIT background, she raised $64M in seed funding (2025) and later a ~$200M round valuing Axiom at about $1.6B.
people.bioZh: 洪乐潼是 AI 创业公司 Axiom 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司致力于打造能生成并形式化验证数学证明的「AI 数学家」。她拥有数学奥赛与 MIT 背景,曾是斯坦福数学博士生和罗德学者;公司先后完成 6400 万美元种子轮融资(2025 年)及约 2 亿美元后续融资,估值约 16 亿美元。

episodes.tEn: Verified AI: Scaling Brilliance Through Formal Verification
Axiom Math: Building a Self-Improving Reasoning Engine with AI Mathematician

views.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that couples generation with verification, grounded in formal languages like Lean.
views.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：一个把生成与验证耦合起来的自我改进推理引擎，以 Lean 等形式化语言为根基。

views.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach math AI or superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向数学 AI 或超级智能；可靠证明必须依赖形式化验证。

views.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement: verified generation improves performance and sample efficiency over informal methods.
views.zh: 验证是性能增益，而非痛苦的要求：相比非形式化方法，经过验证的生成带来性能提升与样本效率。

views.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, since grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为在没有解的情况下为陈述建立根基才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial: AI proofs may be ugly yet converge toward human-like intuition, as with Ramanujan.
views.zh: 人类品味与直觉依然关键：AI 的证明可能丑陋，却能像拉马努金那样收敛到类人的直觉。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Platform (API) at OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI 平台(API)产品负责人
people.bioEn: Olivier Godement is Head of Product for OpenAI's developer platform (API), which he has led since May 2023, overseeing products such as the Responses API and Agents SDK. A French product leader, he previously spent over eight years at Stripe and studied at Sciences Po and ESSEC.
people.bioZh: Olivier Godement 自 2023 年 5 月起担任 OpenAI 开发者平台(API)产品负责人,主导 Responses API、Agents SDK 等面向开发者的产品。他是法国籍产品负责人,加入 OpenAI 前曾在 Stripe 工作 8 年以上,毕业于巴黎政治学院与 ESSEC 商学院。

episodes.tEn: 2025: The Year of Enterprise Coding

people.tiEn: Head of Research Product Management, Anthropic
