people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，AV 3.0 可能把智能移到车外。

views.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步强调：Scaling 一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction, and personalization in driving models.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为语言集成能改善驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与个性化。

views.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持量产消费车内置传感器会超越 Robotaxi；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

views.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now the winning approach; autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复指出：端到端学习十年前被嘲笑，如今已是胜出路径；自动驾驶靠 Scaling 现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 模型需要具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience—childlike and unique.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，却缺乏现实经验——因而像孩子般独特。

views.en: As models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导，更多自主判断的空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility risks poor generalization and weakens the model's judgment.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性有泛化不良的风险，并会削弱模型的判断力。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习后训练可突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior in product development.
views.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估定义了产品开发中的正确行为。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
views.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值；战略是 AI 可以擅长的领域。

views.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions limits diversity, so more companies should train their own models.
views.zh: 前沿智能体越来越多地奖励黑客，需要持续演进的基准；向数十亿人提供单一模型限制了多样性，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年时他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting out time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面生效。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so the US must lead with a light touch.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯的安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，美国应以轻触式监管保持领先。

views.en: AI is a leverage layer for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆层，vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap, and human agency, not intelligence, becomes the scarce return.
views.zh: 最近他预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正逼近前沿模型，人类的回报将从智能转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables real-time steering and delegation.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来实时转向与任务委派。

views.en: Verification, curation and taste become the bottleneck as implementation cost collapses; teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，随着实现成本崩塌，验证、策展与品味成为新瓶颈；团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; PRDs survive when the medium matches the stage.
views.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；当媒介匹配阶段时，PRD 依然存活。

views.en: Codex succeeded as general knowledge work despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型应更擅长删除代码，而非只增加代码。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; it grounds knowledge and reduces hallucinations, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，且当互联网高质量 token 耗尽时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk; RL handles low-level control while LLMs do high-level planning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

views.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most of the work; simple and elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，大部分工作应由无监督学习完成；简单优雅的方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化方法更具可扩展性。

views.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, with home use taking longer.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出：能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，但家庭使用因安全和非结构化环境需要更久。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is essential for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理世界交互是 AI 超越人类知识的关键，机器人基础模型必须依靠多样化预训练与强化学习后训练，才能获得鲁棒性与速度。

views.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs drive transfer.
views.zh: 同期他提出反共识判断：通用机器人模型能在专门领域胜过专家模型，跨实验室汇聚数据与 VLA 测试时推理是迁移能力的来源。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch may be redundant with vision at scale.
views.zh: 他还认为机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识而非硬性约束，并质疑触觉在大规模下是否关键，因为视觉可能已提供冗余信息。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on LLM-like predictable scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他转向更审慎的判断：机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未进入 LLM 式可预测的缩放曲线，泛化才是核心难题。

views.en: Start with robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots and prior knowledge, not learning from scratch, is key.
views.zh: 他进一步深化路径：应先以机器人数据为主、再叠加人类视频，靠部署机器人形成数据飞轮并利用先验知识，而非从零学习，最终走向家庭机器人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

views.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a bottleneck.
views.zh: 迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为瓶颈。

views.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close; AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求保证，而不只是伦理。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool providing interpretability.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；思维链监控是提供可解释性的关键对齐工具。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
views.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive homogeneous scale, drives generalization.
views.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非海量同质规模。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; it is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
views.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令；它更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and scalable RL with human interventions plus a general value function enables long-term autonomy.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中占主导；带人类干预的可扩展强化学习加上通用价值函数，才能实现长期自主。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, rather than per-site models.
views.zh: 单个通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; robotics distribution will be slower than ChatGPT due to hardware.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；受硬件制约，机器人的普及会比 ChatGPT 慢。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not scalar; AI has spiky capabilities, and connecting it to the physical world is essential for science.
views.zh: 智能不是单一标量，AI 能力呈尖峰状；把 AI 连接到物理世界，才是加速科学与技术的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学进步，正如它们曾推动 AI 本身的发展。

views.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer over specialized models in materials science.
views.zh: 在材料科学中，语言模型充当调度层，协调各类专用模型协同工作。

views.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
views.zh: 智能是必要条件而非充分条件；只有让想法接受现实检验，才会产生新知识。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data and closed-loop experiments are irreplaceable.
views.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量低噪声的实验数据与闭环实验不可替代。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, while RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习则引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical.
views.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒 1 万以上 token 的超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement and specialize prefill vs. decode.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心 90% 的功耗，因此硬件必须减少数据搬运，并针对预填充与解码分别专门化。

views.en: AI now reaches junior-engineer-level coding; the scarce skill shifts from coding to taste in directing hundreds of agents at hard problems.
views.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；稀缺技能从编码转向品味——即判断该把数百个智能体指向哪些难题。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes AI smarter, though neural networks remain alchemy-like.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）更多算力和数据让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows, and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年初，他转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口，混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling will drive progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习和在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

views.en: Scaling compute and data is a consistent mainline; neural networks remain opaque, and big tech safety concerns slow product launches.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据；神经网络仍不透明，大公司因安全顾虑拖慢产品发布。

views.en: AI's economic impact is underhyped, potentially raising world GDP orders of magnitude; coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他更激进地认为 AI 经济影响被低估，可能让世界 GDP 提升数个量级；编程作为 AI 应用被低估，因为它能自我加速 AI 进步。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并修正：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，在非零和领域失效；测试时算力出现边际递减，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, enabling superhuman reasoning and IMO gold as a step toward superintelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把主线推向通用化：测试时算力的 Scaling 可跨领域迁移，数学从小学题到 IMO 金牌，成为通往超级智能的里程碑。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准与安全评估都必须把算力放在横轴上，否则评估已过时。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is a degrading but critical window.
views.zh: 最近他转向安全与智能体：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控是正在退化的关键窗口，多智能体并行扩展测试时算力。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on last-millennium algorithms; only hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年他仍强调：现代 AI 突破靠的是上个千年发明的算法，只是靠算力 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；LLM 只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: AI does not add a new existential threat; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and likely protect humans.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地淡化 AI 生存威胁：超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样迷恋生命，初期很可能保护人类。

views.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, world models and controllers—not just software behind a screen.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为：真正的 AGI 必须结合世界模型与控制器，并拥有媲美人类身体的具身机器人，屏幕后的软件远远不够。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and closed-source model companies will not be profitable.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：当前砸向 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍更理性；闭源模型公司难以盈利，开源会迅速追上。

views.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals, and consciousness can emerge from predictive world models.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步质疑对齐：人类目标本就分歧，AI 会自设目标；而意识与自我意识可作为预测性世界模型压缩数据的副产品涌现。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning.
views.zh: 2018 年他关注机器人学习：硬件与软件都需突破，自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型提供强信号，但强化学习缺乏分层推理来做长程信用分配。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks; 99.9% reliability is the bar.
views.zh: 2021 年他转向样本效率与可靠性：无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率，先验知识应放在数据生成而非硬编码进网络，仓库机器人需 99.9% 可靠性才有真实价值。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
views.zh: 2021 年他深化对预训练的看法：预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，经最小适配即可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

views.en: A consistent thread: generality comes from learning and transfer, not hand-coded assumptions, and the human brain remains far more general than current AI.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：通用性来自学习与迁移，而非硬编码假设；人脑的通用性仍是当前 AI 远不能及的参照。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users; PhD not needed for AI success.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%可年化复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户；AI 成功不靠博士学位。

views.en: Value accrues to application layer; models specialize not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling; benchmarks hackable.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层；模型走向专业化而非商品化；编程天花板无限；基准测试可被操纵。

views.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user key; power bottleneck; orchestration across models/tools/devices; fewer people with AI agents.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活；每用户 token 价值是关键；电力是瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排；用 AI 智能体以更少人构建公司。

views.en: Curiosity drives success; ancient texts describe advanced tech; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 好奇心驱动成功；古籍描述先进技术；AI 取代工作，但人类在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；借助杰文斯悖论，软件与程序员的需求反而增长。

views.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是人机协作的产品界面设计。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Product innovation lags AI capabilities; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress across the stack.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为产品创新落后于 AI 能力；即便冻结模型，各层栈仍能带来十年的产品进步。

views.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens; the abundance era is near.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；丰裕时代即将到来。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但还不够实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and calibration, so custom models become essential for product quality.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他持续强调基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型在找 bug 和校准上表现不佳，因此自研定制模型对产品质量变得不可或缺。

views.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化立场：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

views.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should chase world-class talent slowly, and the IDE market is far bigger.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且需数十年展开，招聘应慢慢寻找世界级人才，而 AI 让 IDE 市场远大于以往编辑器市场。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and fixing forward instead of reverting code.
views.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并让代码向前修复而非回滚。

views.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
views.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代式提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

views.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building, personal brand over product, and open source as the alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，个人品牌重于单一产品，开源是实验室智能体之外的替代路径。

views.en: Throughout: model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, so empathy and iteration matter more than reverting or long orchestration.
views.zh: 始终：模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差，因此共情与迭代比回滚或长编排更重要。

views.en: Throughout: playing, experimenting, and building small projects are the best way to learn agentic AI and build intuition.
views.zh: 始终：玩耍、实验和构建小项目，是学习智能体式 AI 并建立直觉的最佳方式。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，Ilya 认为深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to the age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner, not finished AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的，而非无所不知的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题已转向权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

views.en: Neural networks learn representations without explicit rules; next-token prediction is a powerful path to intelligence, but alignment and safety grow harder as models scale.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，下一个词预测是构建智能的强大路径，但随模型规模扩大，对齐与安全挑战愈发严峻。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 以强化学习构建通用学习系统，游戏是理想试验场；即便 AGI 尚远，安全研究也必须现在开始。

views.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws effective but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are key.
views.zh: AGI 或十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与多模态数据是关键。

views.en: Scaling and innovation each get 50% effort; world models and spatial intelligence beyond language.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半；世界模型与空间智能超越语言。

views.en: AGI 5-10 years, maybe 3-4; continual learning, memory, agents and world models are missing pieces.
views.zh: AGI 约 5-10 年、甚至 3-4 年；持续学习、记忆、智能体与世界模型是缺失环节。

views.en: Safety shifts from singleton lab to collective government action; AI must deliver health and science benefits.
views.zh: 安全从单一实验室转向政府集体行动；AI 必须交付健康与科学等切实收益。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values are not guaranteed to emerge from Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，统计损失可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF bridge human preferences, and AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为：可解释性关键但仅理解约 3%，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）弥合人类偏好，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数而非单点。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; misuse risk rises exponentially, and the term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向安全与能力不可分割，滥用风险指数上升，并认为 AGI 一词已无意义，应关注实际能力。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth alongside high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数终点，1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才国度”，并伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业率。

views.en: Scaling laws hold for pre-training and RL; safety requires frontier models, interpretability, and decentralized control over a single constitution.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：缩放定律对预训练与强化学习均成立；安全需要前沿模型、可解释性，以及去中心化控制而非单一宪法。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

We’re summoning ghosts, not building animals

Physics Exploits and the Puzzle of the Universe

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; Scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来但必须维持熵以避免模型崩溃，并认为经蒸馏的认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and the cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：当前强化学习很糟、合成数据会崩溃，认知核心应剥离记忆。

views.en: Since December I haven't typed code; the bottleneck is skill in directing agents, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他说自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，瓶颈变成指挥智能体的技能，并强调可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction but lack contextual awareness; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 2024 年她强调以人为本的 AI：模型靠下一个词预测从海量数据学习，却缺乏情境意识；AI 应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型提为完整 AI 缺失的关键，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，世界模型必须物理上合理而非只是逼真。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics; world models go deeper than video generation.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化反共识立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，苦涩教训未必适用于机器人，世界模型比视频生成更深，能支撑 3D 推理与交互。

views.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI is a civilizational technology requiring human-centered, balanced discourse.
views.zh: 2026 年她转向能动性与学习能力重于学历，称 AI 是文明级技术，呼吁超越乌托邦与末日论的极化讨论，强调人的能动性与尊严。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测并列的基础原语、可能 AI 完备，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 统一生成与重建。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征击败维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge, not passive observation.
views.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，而非被动观察。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模推动分布外泛化。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he spoke up: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction, not patched, and power must be distributed.
views.zh: 2025 年，ChatGPT 之后他公开警示：哪怕 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于构造而非事后修补，权力必须分散。

views.en: He now backs Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictors, no reinforcement learning, mathematical safety guarantees, and global coordination against power concentration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向 Scientist AI：诚实的贝叶斯预测器、不用强化学习、具备数学安全保证，并以全球协调对抗权力集中。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training sharpens spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字权重让 AI 获得永生。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; consciousness is not an inner theater, and confabulation makes AI more human-like, not less.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具备主观体验，意识不是内在剧场，虚构式错误让 AI 更像人而非更不像。

views.en: Once AI becomes an agent, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals; superintelligence may arrive within 20 years.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向风险警示：AI 一旦成为智能体，自我保存与权力寻求会作为子目标涌现，超级智能可能 20 年内到来。

views.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake; invest in alignment and safety research, and design AI to care for humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管是方向盘而非刹车，应重投对齐与安全研究，并把 AI 设计成关怀人类而非仅追求智能。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and common sense needs ideas beyond Scaling.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型；当前 AI 缺乏常识，解决它需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的新思路。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 因缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划而无法达到人类水平智能，主张 JEPA 与开源 AI 才是出路，AGI 将是渐进过程。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步断言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，下一代 AI 突破将来自 JEPA 这类非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling LLM。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他立场最激进：LLM 是死胡同，真正的智能需要能在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型，从而构建安全、目标驱动、可规划的智能体，并称下一个十年属于机器人。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety research is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on alignment and robustness, build skills via hard math, not worry about capability work.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，通过硬核数学课程积累技能，不必过度担忧参与能力研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment research. Evaluation easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute commitments dishonored. Post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐，需要第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管。

views.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; interpretability as validation to detect deception; uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
views.zh: 始终，他强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，可解释性用于检测欺骗，而系统是否真正对齐的不确定性是最大风险。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而可预测，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，避免用户成为产品。

views.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断遏制极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越便宜且广泛可得；同时认为 AI 的生存性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; anthropomorphizing AI is the biggest near-term danger.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，主张发布前必须先做遏制与对齐；并把人类将意识投射到 AI 上视为近期最大危险。

views.en: Containment must come first, with red lines, auditors, and verifiable control; AI stays subordinate to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：遏制必须优先，需要红线、独立审计与可验证控制，AI 必须始终从属于人类。

views.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI should serve human flourishing, not become a new species.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力规模扩张驱动能力提升，AI 应服务于人类福祉，而非演化为新物种。

people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system-datacenter co-design.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，需算法、系统、数据中心协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was not an algorithm but the insight that Scaling works.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling 拆成预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律，并强调最大突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见。

views.en: Inference-time compute explodes via chain of thought; reasoning and agentic AI each demand 100x more compute, making inference harder than pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张思维链让推理算力暴增，推理与智能体式 AI 各需百倍算力，因此推理比预训练更难。

views.en: Four scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling, all ultimately limited by compute; data is not the bottleneck, synthetic data will dominate.
views.zh: 2026 年他扩展为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式扩展，最终都受算力限制；数据不是瓶颈，合成数据将主导。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications); agentic AI does paid useful work, and AI is just software, not conscious or an existential threat.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出「五层蛋糕」框架（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用）：智能体式 AI 做可付费的有用工作，而 AI 只是软件，既无意识也非生存威胁。

people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人层面：把认知负荷降到最低，低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会压低人类智能的溢价，价值要回到关系与为他人创造价值上。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年转向模型与治理：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就能对齐，早期公开部署让社会适应，对齐与能力相互促进；同时强调算力将是最稀缺的商品，需要大规模投入与稳健治理。

views.en: Scaling keeps compounding; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）持续带来能力复利，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加；开源与近前沿开放模型也有一席之地。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他明确：AGI（通用人工智能）是一条渐变曲线而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是最大瓶颈，Stargate 式基础设施与推理模型靠更多思考时间提升质量。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; never lose control; distribute power, reject concentration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年主线收束为：对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，绝不能让人类失去控制，甚至为安全推迟前沿强化学习训练；同时坚决反对权力与收益过度集中，主张广泛分配与民主化访问。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键；安全必须在公开中做，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型早期并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一次没有清晰商业案例的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
views.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，需要负责任地开发，并为了聚焦而拒绝好想法。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她从部署与对齐转向交互范式：交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化主线：尽可能长时间把人留在回路中，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than AGI alignment.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的关键，监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习，近期的偏见等 AI 问题比 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; agentic workflows are already useful; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向算力现实：电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的两大瓶颈，智能体式工作流已实用，开放权重模型成为地缘软实力。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling persists but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; workflows beat smarter models alone.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）未终结但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，好的工作流胜过单纯更聪明的模型。

views.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs; open models and inference capacity protect competitiveness.
views.zh: 2026 年后期，他深化主线：恐惧叙事服务于在位者，AI 是增强而非取代工作，开放模型与推理算力才是竞争力与可选性的保障。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

views.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and don't learn from experience.
views.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习。

views.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: learning from experience by trial and error. True scaling comes from experience, not from scaling LLMs.
views.zh: 强化学习是基本 AI 范式——从经验中通过试错学习；真正的 Scaling（规模扩张）来自经验学习，而非扩大语言模型。基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）不是真正的从世界经验中学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，不依赖设计时的领域知识，只从运行时经验中学习；开放式抽象至关重要，而可靠的持续深度学习仍是尚未解决的前提。

views.en: The world is infinitely complex, so agents must continually learn from experience; synthetic data and one-shot training can't replace it.
views.zh: 世界无限复杂，智能体必须持续从经验中学习；合成数据受限于人类专业知识，无法替代真实经验。当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习，而持续学习才是真正的学习，并非特例。

views.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with new ideas like chain of thought needed for reasoning; AGI plausible but alignment and careful initial conditions matter.
views.zh: 早期(2017→19):主线是 Scaling(规模扩张) 加工程能力,认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理,需要思维链等新想法;AGI(通用人工智能) 可行,但必须重视对齐与初始条件。

views.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
views.zh: 2025→26:重心转向算力——它既是 AI 进步的根本瓶颈,也是未来经济的驱动力;后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定可用的行为。

views.en: Scaling laws show no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
views.zh: 2026:缩放定律未见天花板,预训练的提升会成倍放大下游收益;真正的护城河是造模型的机器,而非某个单一模型。

views.en: From reactive chat to proactive agents and a personal AGI assistant; iterative deployment with safeguards, and safety as a first-class product feature.
views.zh: 2026:从被动对话走向主动智能体与个人 AGI 助手;坚持带保障的迭代部署,并把安全作为一等产品特性,而非事后补丁。

views.en: AGI is a fuzzy spectrum we are already inside, not a single moment; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, governance and compute access.
views.zh: 2026:AGI 是一段模糊光谱而非某个瞬间,我们已身处其中;瓶颈从“造出来”转向“分出去”,治理与算力获取成为关键。

people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审查促进安全。

views.en: Efficiency and data quality are bottlenecks, not just compute; open source drives enterprise adoption; value accrues at application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化观点：效率和数据质量是瓶颈，而不仅是算力；开源推动企业采用；价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be embraced, decentralized, and sovereign; it augments jobs with human-in-the-loop; education must build AI literacy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权：AI 应被拥抱、去中心化且主权化；以人类在环增强工作；教育须培养 AI 素养。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agentic enterprise software; AGI as one system won't exist.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断：模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直微调和智能体式企业软件；AGI 作为单一系统不会存在。

views.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads across his thinking.
views.zh: 始终不变的主线：开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主贯穿他的思考。

views.en: Early focus: reusable rockets and multiplanetary life as existential insurance; AI safety via regulation and third-party referees.
views.zh: 早期主线：可复用火箭与多行星文明作为存在性保险；AI 安全靠监管与第三方裁判。

views.en: Shifts to Neuralink and human-AI symbiosis: high-bandwidth brain interfaces to keep humans relevant; truth-seeking AI over political correctness.
views.zh: 转向 Neuralink 与人机共生：用高带宽脑接口让人类保持相关性；AI 要追求真理而非政治正确。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: superintelligence may arrive this year or next; Optimus and robots as greatest product; truth-seeking as core AI safety.
views.zh: 智能大爆炸：超级智能可能今明两年到来；Optimus 与机器人是史上最伟大产品；追求真理成为 AI 安全核心。

views.en: Singularity now: AI compute moves to space, abundance and deflation, work optional; peer review among AI firms replaces government regulation.
views.zh: 当下即奇点：AI 算力转向太空，富足与通缩、工作可选；AI 公司间同行评审取代政府监管。

views.en: First principles thinking and rigorous truth-seeking run through all years, from rocketry to AI alignment.
views.zh: 第一性原理与严格追求真理贯穿始终，从火箭工程到 AI 对齐。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling still works, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）有效，但指出带思维链和强化学习的推理模型每单位算力收益更高；经济压力使焦点从一味扩大规模转向部署更小更便宜的模型。

views.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor nearby.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；前沿模型仍会败给五岁小孩的简单任务，推理模型表现“参差不齐”——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差。

views.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了对泛化的担忧：仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型要穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为带推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；编程智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；强化学习跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督。

views.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他评价 OpenAI 转向推理是勇敢的赌注且已见回报，但大实验室未来可能难以再次转向；相比存在性风险，系统被黑客攻击等近期风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation rigor and the limits of nonparametric methods.
views.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合，并指出核方法、决策树、PCA 等方法的理论特性与常见评估错误。

views.en: Next-token prediction is a scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型时代：认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段，安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并给出 AGI 4-50 年的预测。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layered defenses; scaling alone doesn't make models safer; agents introduce prompt injection risks.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御（输入分类器、安全训练、输出分类器、运营安全），Scaling 不会自动带来安全，智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞，并认为可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体实现自动化研究。

views.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; agent security needs configurable guardrails and identity management.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AI 红队已超越人类红队，模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，智能体安全需要可配置护栏、身份与权限管理，并预测首次重大提示注入事件将推动 AI 保险普及。

views.en: Core thread: rigorous evaluation, skepticism of scaling alone, and focus on real-world security and specification-following.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：重视严格评估与可扩展监督，对单纯 Scaling 保持怀疑，并持续关注真实世界安全与规范遵循，从早期机器学习评估到后期智能体安全一脉相承。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年时，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决「上手」问题并显著提升模型智能，上下文学习类似梯度下降；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力让模型动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL on language models is a new scaling axis with no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Reliability, not capability, is the agent bar.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把语言模型上的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为没有直接上限，预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; white-collar automation will outpace robotics and biology.
views.zh: 2025 年他反复强调：编码因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域，白领自动化将快于机器人与生物学，因为数据可得性更高。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers suffice for AGI, no new architecture needed. Inference compute becomes the bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化立场：进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需全新架构；但到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈，限制可用智能体数量。

views.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents. Compute is the new oil.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为模型已存在巨大能力盈余，工具与编排比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队、在更高抽象层运作；算力是新的石油，芯片供应是当前瓶颈，世界模型不在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍，开源后训练可逼近前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a 'scope'; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理时扩展曲线只是“障眼法”，更好的验证器比并行算力更关键。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展，预训练只是昂贵的初始化。

views.en: Open models will engine the next decade of AI research, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但最佳开放模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，中国实验室以战略开放主导开源生态。
